_sample_note: Sample 03 (reference suite): two concurrent Auto Loader ingestion flows plus an in-DAG reconciliation flow comparing their targets, all assets isolated in the {{catalog}}.metaflow_sample schema. execution_mode is 'pipeline_audit_only': the L3 prepare and L4 compare datasets (recon__<id>__<target>__classified/__metrics/__mismatch, published to publish_schema) are registered INSIDE this pipeline's own Lakeflow DAG, while the L5 heal lane stays with the standalone job engine -- which is why append_target_table is still present (spec_validator.py requires it for comparison_direction 'source_to_target', and it is what a standalone 05_reconciliation_engine.py run would heal into; nothing in THIS pipeline reads or writes it). V-CYC rules observed: the recon source is this group's own APPEND streaming_table target (append-only producer), dataflow_group_id is declared on the flow (mandatory in pipeline modes), both sides read batch, and append_target_table is neither an in-spec target nor either compared side. The seed notebook (notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/04_seed_sample_03_multi_table_recon_data.py) injects controlled drift per iteration -- iteration 1 lands identical primary/replica slices, iteration 2 drifts a few replica fare values, iteration 3 omits some replica rows entirely -- so the recon metrics move visibly across the 3 pipeline updates (see the seed notebook header for the expected metric deltas).

ingestion_flows.source_description: Sample 03: primary NYC-taxi trip feed (samples.nyctaxi.trips slices with a deterministic seed-assigned ride_id), Auto Loader-ingested into an APPEND streaming table -- the reconciliation flow's SOURCE side, and therefore deliberately an append-only producer (V-CYC-7).

Sample 03: replica NYC-taxi trip feed -- the same seed-generated slices as the primary feed, with controlled per-iteration drift (value drifts in iteration 2, missing rows in iteration 3) so the reconciliation flow has real discrepancies to classify.
